import {
  initProject,
  type InitProjectOptions,
  type InitProjectResult,
} from 'agentic-report';

type Equal<Left, Right> =
  (<Value>() => Value extends Left ? 1 : 2) extends
  (<Value>() => Value extends Right ? 1 : 2)
    ? true
    : false;
type Assert<Value extends true> = Value;
type ParameterContract = Assert<
  Equal<Parameters<typeof initProject>, [options: InitProjectOptions]>
>;
type ReturnContract = Assert<
  Equal<Awaited<ReturnType<typeof initProject>>, InitProjectResult>
>;
type OptionsKeys = Assert<Equal<keyof InitProjectOptions, 'destination' | 'starter'>>;
type ResultKeys = Assert<
  Equal<
    keyof InitProjectResult,
    'starterId' | 'starterTitle' | 'projectPath' | 'entryPath' | 'files'
  >
>;

const defaultStarter: InitProjectOptions = { destination: './project' };
const namedStarter: InitProjectOptions = { destination: './project', starter: 'basic' };
const completeResult: InitProjectResult = {
  starterId: 'basic',
  starterTitle: 'Basic starter',
  projectPath: '/tmp/project',
  entryPath: '/tmp/project/report.md',
  files: ['report.md'],
};

// @ts-expect-error destination is required.
const missingDestination: InitProjectOptions = {};
// @ts-expect-error destination must be a string.
const invalidDestination: InitProjectOptions = { destination: 1 };
// @ts-expect-error starter must be a string when present.
const invalidStarter: InitProjectOptions = { destination: './project', starter: 1 };
// @ts-expect-error unknown option fields are not part of the public contract.
const extraOption: InitProjectOptions = { destination: './project', overwrite: true };
// @ts-expect-error unknown result fields are not part of the public contract.
const extraResult: InitProjectResult = { ...completeResult, mode: 'unsafe' };
// @ts-expect-error option members are readonly.
defaultStarter.destination = './changed';
// @ts-expect-error optional starter remains readonly when present.
namedStarter.starter = 'changed';

async function assertResult(): Promise<void> {
  const result: InitProjectResult = await initProject(defaultStarter);
  await initProject(namedStarter);
  const starterId: string = result.starterId;
  const starterTitle: string = result.starterTitle;
  const projectPath: string = result.projectPath;
  const entryPath: string = result.entryPath;
  const files: readonly string[] = result.files;
  // @ts-expect-error result identity members are readonly.
  result.starterId = 'changed';
  // @ts-expect-error result identity members are readonly.
  result.starterTitle = 'changed';
  // @ts-expect-error result identity members are readonly.
  result.projectPath = './changed';
  // @ts-expect-error result identity members are readonly.
  result.entryPath = './changed';
  // @ts-expect-error the file inventory property is readonly.
  result.files = [];
  // @ts-expect-error the public file inventory is readonly.
  result.files.push('mutation');
  // @ts-expect-error every result identity field is required.
  const incomplete: InitProjectResult = { starterId, projectPath, entryPath, files };
  void starterTitle;
  void incomplete;
}

void missingDestination;
void invalidDestination;
void invalidStarter;
void extraOption;
void extraResult;
void completeResult;
void (null as unknown as ParameterContract);
void (null as unknown as ReturnContract);
void (null as unknown as OptionsKeys);
void (null as unknown as ResultKeys);
void assertResult;
